title: Men's Farmer – No Days Off. The Cows Said So. Hoodie

seo.title: Farmer Hoodie – No Days Off. The Cows Said So.
seo.description: A funny farmer hoodie for early chores: NO DAYS OFF. THE COWS SAID SO. Gildan pullover, 8 oz fleece, Sand or Navy.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

NO DAYS OFF. THE COWS SAID SO. is the farmer hoodie for dairy hands and farm families who are up for chores at 5 a.m. every single day, worn to the barn, the feed store and Christmas morning.

NO DAYS OFF. runs across the top in heavy slab capitals and THE COWS SAID SO. fills the bottom, even wider. Between them a weary farmer in a barn coat, cap and muck boots trudges through the mud at dawn with a steel milk pail and a steaming thermos cup while a black-and-white dairy cow leans out of the open barn door behind him, waiting.

Navy carries cream and mustard lettering with a cream edge around the barn; Sand gets barn-red-brown and dark navy lettering. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

Is this hoodie warm enough for a cold barn morning?
Yes. The No Days Off. The Cows Said So. hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a Gildan 18500 pullover in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, with a double-lined hood and a front pouch pocket. It is an easy layer for 5 a.m. chores, frozen water buckets and long days in the barnyard.

How does the No Days Off. The Cows Said So. hoodie fit?
It is a classic unisex cut in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomier layer over a work shirt. If it is not right, Graphic Tees Co. offers a free size exchange, so the first pick carries no risk at all.

Is this a good gift for a farmer or dairy hand?
It is a natural one. Every farm family knows the cows set the schedule, so it lands with dairy hands, ranchers and the kids buying for dad. It comes in Sand and Navy, prints to order, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess on size.

How do I wash the hoodie so the print lasts?
Turn the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie inside out, wash it in cold water with similar colors and tumble dry on low. Skip bleach and ironing on the print. The design is printed directly on the fabric, so gentle care keeps the lettering and the farmer sharp wash after wash.

When should I order for Christmas delivery?
Order by about December 8 to have the No Days Off. The Cows Said So. hoodie for Christmas. Each Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is printed to order after you buy, and shipping is free on orders over $45. Orders placed after that date may arrive after the holiday, so earlier is safer.
